sloka: एवं ते कृतदारा वै रेमिरे तत्र राक्षसाः ।स्वां स्वां भार्यामुपागम्य गन्धर्वा इव नन्दने ।। ७.१२.२७ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ te kṛtadārā vai remire tatra rākṣasāḥ ।svāṁ svāṁ bhāryāmupāgamya gandharvā iva nandane ।। 7.12.27 ॥

translations.english: Thus, having taken wives, those Rakshasas indeed enjoyed themselves there, approaching their respective wives, just like Gandharvas in the Nandana garden.
